video_title: Maverick Carter on LeBron James’ NBA Career, The Decision, & Building a Billion-Dollar Blueprint

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' competitive drive and ego will last until he dies
quotes.excerpt: He's LeBron James, his ego until he's dead is going to tell him, 'I could get a bucket'
quotes.quote: He's LeBron James, his ego until he's dead is going to tell him, 'I could get a bucket in this game.' That's insane. That doesn't even make sense, unless you're Michael Jordan.

quotes.speaker: Rich Kleiman
quotes.summary_phrase: The end of LeBron James' and Maverick Carter's era in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: This is clearly at the tail-tail end of his career and a lot of ways an era
quotes.quote: This is clearly at the tail-tail end of his career and a lot of ways an era in your life. Is there not a sadness in any of this? Because I've talked about this with Kevin, whether putting all of the other stuff aside, there's a level of, 'Damn, this is really coming to an end.'

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' retirement timeline and his desire to keep playing
quotes.excerpt: If you really want to play, then keep playing. Play as long as you can, why not?
quotes.quote: He's talked a bit during the season. I think about two or three years ago he first mentioned the word retirement. Not until like year 20, year 21. I didn't think he would get to play again, but I said, 'Listen, if you really want to play, then keep playing. Play as long as you can, why not?' Because one day you won't be able to.

quotes.speaker: Rich Kleiman
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of elite athletes transitioning away from professional basketball
quotes.excerpt: When Patrick Ewing got traded to Seattle and they went to Orlando, we all could have told him
quotes.quote: When Patrick Ewing got traded to Seattle and they went to Orlando, we all could have told him it was over. That era of basketball towards the end of their career, it was done. You could see it was done physically. It is interesting for LeBron, more than anybody, but a lot of these guys in this era, he probably will be able to give you eight to 12 points at 55. So him walking away from the game is not ever going to be about his ability.

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' longevity and actual years played in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: He's gotten paid for 23 years to play basketball, but he's been playing basketball more like 34 seasons
quotes.quote: People are like, 'LeBron is amazing, he's played 23 seasons, he's going to play a 24th season.' I'm like, 'No, he's gotten paid for 23 years to play basketball, but he's been playing basketball more like 34 seasons.' He's played 34 seasons.

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Maverick Carter's early career and business partnership with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I left Nike in '06 to work to be full-time with LeBron
quotes.quote: I left Nike in '06 to work to be full-time with LeBron. LeBron had an agent at the time, fired his agent. The same one Kevin fired soon after. And we started a company to manage LeBron. And frankly, I didn't know what the fuck I was doing, the truth. I mean, I knew the only thing I knew is I had to get smart people. I knew the buckets, like we need some legal, we need accounting. I knew those things and I knew how to find people.

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Maverick Carter's business partnership with Mukesh Ambani in India
quotes.excerpt: I have a partner, they name Mukesh Ambani in India, and we own the rights to basketball in India
quotes.quote: I have a partner, they name Mukesh Ambani in India, and we own the rights to basketball in India. He said those words to me. I said, 'You mean like nobody can play basketball in India unless you okay it? What does that even mean?' He goes, 'Let me explain to you what it means. I bought IMG. IMG was the consultant on the IPL, the Indian Premier League, the Cricket League, which has been a great business case.'

quotes.speaker: Maverick Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Maverick Carter's partnership with LeBron James and the NBA
quotes.excerpt: We thought about partnering with the NBA and we had a conversation and David Stern, rest in peace
quotes.quote: We thought about partnering with the NBA and we had a conversation and David Stern, rest in peace, who I actually always really admired. David Stern basically told them, 'Fuck do I need you for? I'm the NBA. I own basketball in the world.' And he said, 'So if I'm not going to do it with the NBA, I'm not. The next best person to partner with me on building a basketball business and league in India is LeBron James.' And that's why I wanted this deal.

quotes.speaker: Rich Kleiman
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' decision to join the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: The answer to the question everybody wants to know, LeBron, what's your decision?
quotes.quote:
The answer to the question everybody wants to know, LeBron, what's your decision? 

LeBron James: 'Um, in this fall, man, it's very tough. Um, in this fall I'm going to take my talents to South Beach and join the Miami Heat.'

quotes.speaker: Rich Kleiman
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' decision to leave Cleveland for Miami
quotes.excerpt: The reality is this is the only reason why it was a big deal is because he left Cleveland
quotes.quote: The reality is this is the only reason why it was a big deal is because he left Cleveland. It's the only reason why like everything Kevin did was a spectacle and a big deal because he left Oklahoma City. Like I say this a lot, Kevin is judged literally by the decisions of the teams he wants to play for. Think about that. The decision on the teams he wants to play for.
